    2	
    3	Works for Anthropic and Anthropic-compatible endpoints (e.g. DeepSeek). The
    4	raw events are kept as-is by the recorder; this module only derives the

   16	@dataclass
   17	class SSEEvent:
   18	    event: str | None  # SSE "event:" name; None for unnamed frames
   19	    data: str  # raw "data:" payload (multi-line data joined with "\n")

   25	class SSEParser:
   26	    """Incremental SSE parser: feed bytes in any chunking, get whole events."""
   27	
   28	    def __init__(self) -> None:
   29	        self._buf = ""
   30	        self._decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder("utf-8")(errors="replace")
   31	        self._event: str | None = None
   32	        self._data: list[str] = []
   33	
   34	    def feed(self, chunk: bytes | str) -> list[SSEEvent]:
   35	        if isinstance(chunk, bytes):
   36	            # incremental: a multi-byte character may be split across chunks
   37	            chunk = self._decoder.decode(chunk)
   38	        self._buf += chunk
   39	        out: list[SSEEvent] = []
   40	        while True:
   41	            idx = self._buf.find("\n")
   42	            if idx < 0:
   43	                break
   44	            line = self._buf[:idx].rstrip("\r")
   45	            self._buf = self._buf[idx + 1 :]
   46	            ev = self._line(line)
   47	            if ev is not None:
   48	                out.append(ev)
   49	        return out
   50	
   51	    def flush(self) -> list[SSEEvent]:
   52	        """Call at end of stream to emit a final event lacking a blank line."""
   53	        tail = self._decoder.decode(b"", final=True)
   54	        out = self.feed(tail + "\n") if (self._buf or tail) else []
   55	        ev = self._dispatch()
   56	        if ev is not None:
   57	            out.append(ev)
   58	        return out
   59	
   60	    def _line(self, line: str) -> SSEEvent | None:
   61	        if line == "":

   63	        if line.startswith(":"):  # comment / keep-alive
   64	            return None
   65	        field, _, value = line.partition(":")
   66	        if value.startswith(" "):
   67	            value = value[1:]
   68	        if field == "event":
   69	            self._event = value
   70	        elif field == "data":
   71	            self._data.append(value)
   72	        return None
   73	
   74	    def _dispatch(self) -> SSEEvent | None:
   75	        if self._event is None and not self._data:
   76	            return None

   78	        self._event, self._data = None, []

   28	    def __init__(self) -> None:

   30	        self._decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder("utf-8")(errors="replace")
   31	        self._event: str | None = None
   32	        self._data: list[str] = []

   34	    def feed(self, chunk: bytes | str) -> list[SSEEvent]:

   36	            # incremental: a multi-byte character may be split across chunks
   37	            chunk = self._decoder.decode(chunk)
   38	        self._buf += chunk
   39	        out: list[SSEEvent] = []
   40	        while True:
   41	            idx = self._buf.find("\n")
   42	            if idx < 0:
   43	                break
   44	            line = self._buf[:idx].rstrip("\r")
   45	            self._buf = self._buf[idx + 1 :]
   46	            ev = self._line(line)
   47	            if ev is not None:
   48	                out.append(ev)

   51	    def flush(self) -> list[SSEEvent]:

   56	        if ev is not None:

   70	        elif field == "data":

1	"""Wire-format adapters: Anthropic Messages and OpenAI Chat Completions.
    2	
    3	Everything format-specific lives here, so the rest of ctxblame works on the
    4	neutral ``Decision`` and ``Usage`` types.
    5	"""
    6	
    7	from __future__ import annotations
    8	
    9	import json
   10	import re
   11	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
   12	
   13	from .sse import assemble_message, assemble_openai_chunks
   14	
   15	ANTHROPIC = "anthropic"
   16	OPENAI = "openai"
   17	
   18	
   19	def detect_format(path: str) -> str | None:
   20	    p = path.split("?", 1)[0].rstrip("/")
   21	    if p.endswith("/v1/messages"):
   22	        return ANTHROPIC
   23	    if p.endswith("/chat/completions"):
   24	        return OPENAI
   25	    return None
   26	
   27	
   28	def assemble_stream(fmt: str, events: list) -> dict:
   29	    return assemble_message(events) if fmt == ANTHROPIC else assemble_openai_chunks(events)
   30	
   31	
   32	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- decisions
   33	
   34	@dataclass(frozen=True)
   35	class ToolCall:
   36	    name: str
   37	    args: dict | str  # str only when the model emitted unparseable JSON
   38	
   39	
   40	@dataclass
   41	class Decision:
   42	    calls: list[ToolCall] = field(default_factory=list)
   43	    text: str = ""
   44	    stop: str | None = None
   45	
   46	    def key(self, key_args: list[str] | None = None, name_only: bool = False) -> str:
   47	        """Comparable label for 'the same decision'.
   48	
   49	        The decision is the first tool call: its name plus normalized
   50	        arguments (all of them, or only ``key_args``). No tool call -> a
   51	        fixed label, so "answered in text" is itself a decision. A key_args
   52	        entry "arg~regex" compares whether the argument matches the regex
   53	        instead of its exact value.
   54	        """
   55	        if not self.calls:
   56	            return "<no tool call>"
   57	        c = self.calls[0]
   58	        if name_only:
   59	            return c.name
   60	        args = c.args
   61	        if isinstance(args, dict) and key_args:
   62	            sel = {}
   63	            for spec in key_args:
   64	                if "~" in spec:  # "arg~regex": does the argument match?
   65	                    k, rx = spec.split("~", 1)
   66	                    v = args.get(k)
   67	                    sel[spec] = v is not None and re.search(rx, str(v)) is not None
   68	                else:
   69	                    sel[spec] = args.get(spec)
   70	            args = sel
   71	        return f"{c.name}({json.dumps(normalize(args), sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False)})"
   72	
   73	
   74	def normalize(v):
   75	    """Ignore formatting noise: surrounding/duplicate whitespace, trailing '/'."""
   76	    if isinstance(v, str):
   77	        s = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", v.strip())
   78	        return s[:-1] if len(s) > 1 and s.endswith("/") else s
   79	    if isinstance(v, dict):
   80	        return {k: normalize(x) for k, x in v.items()}
   81	    if isinstance(v, list):
   82	        return [normalize(x) for x in v]
   83	    return v
   84	
   85	
   86	def _parse_args(s) -> dict | str:
   87	    if isinstance(s, dict):
   88	        return s
   89	    try:
   90	        v = json.loads(s) if s else {}
   91	        return v if isinstance(v, dict) else s
   92	    except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
   93	        return s
   94	
   95	
   96	def extract_decision(fmt: str, response: dict) -> Decision:
   97	    if fmt == ANTHROPIC:
   98	        calls, texts = [], []
   99	        for b in response.get("content") or []:
  100	            if b.get("type") == "tool_use":
  101	                calls.append(ToolCall(b.get("name", ""), _parse_args(b.get("input", {}))))
  102	            elif b.get("type") == "text":
  103	                texts.append(b.get("text", ""))
  104	        return Decision(calls, "".join(texts), response.get("stop_reason"))
  105	    ch = (response.get("choices") or [{}])[0]
  106	    msg = ch.get("message") or {}
  107	    calls = [ToolCall((tc.get("function") or {}).get("name", ""),
  108	                      _parse_args((tc.get("function") or {}).get("arguments", "")))
  109	             for tc in msg.get("tool_calls") or []]
  110	    return Decision(calls, msg.get("content") or "", ch.get("finish_reason"))
  111	
  112	
  113	# -------------------------------------------------------------------- usage
  114	
  115	@dataclass
  116	class Usage:
  117	    input_uncached: int = 0
  118	    input_cache_read: int = 0
  119	    input_cache_write: int = 0
  120	    output: int = 0
  121	
  122	    def __add__(self, o: "Usage") -> "Usage":
  123	        return Usage(self.input_uncached + o.input_uncached, self.input_cache_read + o.input_cache_read,
  124	                     self.input_cache_write + o.input_cache_write, self.output + o.output)
  125	
  126	
  127	def extract_usage(fmt: str, response: dict) -> Usage:
  128	    u = response.get("usage") or {}
  129	    if fmt == ANTHROPIC:
  130	        # input_tokens excludes cache reads/writes (Anthropic and DeepSeek agree)
  131	        return Usage(u.get("input_tokens") or 0, u.get("cache_read_input_tokens") or 0,
  132	                     u.get("cache_creation_input_tokens") or 0, u.get("output_tokens") or 0)
  133	    prompt = u.get("prompt_tokens") or 0
  134	    if "prompt_cache_hit_tokens" in u:  # DeepSeek
  135	        hit = u.get("prompt_cache_hit_tokens") or 0
  136	    else:
  137	        hit = (u.get("prompt_tokens_details") or {}).get("cached_tokens") or 0
  138	    return Usage(prompt, hit, 0, u.get("completion_tokens") or 0)
  139	
  140	
  141	def response_model(response: dict) -> str | None:
  142	    return response.get("model")

1	"""Parse Anthropic-style SSE streams and rebuild the final Message from them.
    2	
    3	Works for Anthropic and Anthropic-compatible endpoints (e.g. DeepSeek). The
    4	raw events are kept as-is by the recorder; this module only derives the
    5	assembled message so later steps can read the decision without re-parsing.
    6	"""
    7	
    8	from __future__ import annotations
    9	
   10	import codecs
   11	import copy
   12	import json
   13	from dataclasses import dataclass
   14	
   15	
   16	@dataclass
   17	class SSEEvent:
   18	    event: str | None  # SSE "event:" name; None for unnamed frames
   19	    data: str  # raw "data:" payload (multi-line data joined with "\n")
   20	
   21	    def to_json(self) -> dict:
   22	        return {"event": self.event, "data": self.data}
   23	
   24	
   25	class SSEParser:
   26	    """Incremental SSE parser: feed bytes in any chunking, get whole events."""
   27	
   28	    def __init__(self) -> None:
   29	        self._buf = ""
   30	        self._decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder("utf-8")(errors="replace")
   31	        self._event: str | None = None
   32	        self._data: list[str] = []
   33	
   34	    def feed(self, chunk: bytes | str) -> list[SSEEvent]:
   35	        if isinstance(chunk, bytes):
   36	            # incremental: a multi-byte character may be split across chunks
   37	            chunk = self._decoder.decode(chunk)
   38	        self._buf += chunk
   39	        out: list[SSEEvent] = []
   40	        while True:
   41	            idx = self._buf.find("\n")
   42	            if idx < 0:
   43	                break
   44	            line = self._buf[:idx].rstrip("\r")
   45	            self._buf = self._buf[idx + 1 :]
   46	            ev = self._line(line)
   47	            if ev is not None:
   48	                out.append(ev)
   49	        return out
   50	
   51	    def flush(self) -> list[SSEEvent]:
   52	        """Call at end of stream to emit a final event lacking a blank line."""
   53	        tail = self._decoder.decode(b"", final=True)
   54	        out = self.feed(tail + "\n") if (self._buf or tail) else []
   55	        ev = self._dispatch()
   56	        if ev is not None:
   57	            out.append(ev)
   58	        return out
   59	
   60	    def _line(self, line: str) -> SSEEvent | None:
   61	        if line == "":
   62	            return self._dispatch()
   63	        if line.startswith(":"):  # comment / keep-alive
   64	            return None
   65	        field, _, value = line.partition(":")
   66	        if value.startswith(" "):
   67	            value = value[1:]
   68	        if field == "event":
   69	            self._event = value
   70	        elif field == "data":
   71	            self._data.append(value)
   72	        return None
   73	
   74	    def _dispatch(self) -> SSEEvent | None:
   75	        if self._event is None and not self._data:
   76	            return None
   77	        ev = SSEEvent(self._event, "\n".join(self._data))
   78	        self._event, self._data = None, []
   79	        return ev
   80	
   81	
   82	def parse_sse(text: bytes | str) -> list[SSEEvent]:
   83	    p = SSEParser()
   84	    return p.feed(text) + p.flush()
   85	
   86	
   87	class StreamError(Exception):
   88	    pass
   89	
   90	
   91	def assemble_message(events: list[SSEEvent | dict]) -> dict:
   92	    """Rebuild the non-streaming Message object from a list of SSE events.
   93	
   94	    Returns a dict shaped like a normal Messages API response, plus
   95	    ``_stream_complete`` (False if ``message_stop`` never arrived) and
   96	    ``_stream_error`` when the stream carried an error frame.
   97	    """
   98	    msg: dict | None = None
   99	    blocks: dict[int, dict] = {}
  100	    partial_json: dict[int, str] = {}
  101	    complete = False
  102	    error = None
  103	
  104	    for raw in events:
  105	        if isinstance(raw, dict):
  106	            raw = SSEEvent(raw.get("event"), raw.get("data", ""))
  107	        if not raw.data:
  108	            continue
  109	        try:
  110	            payload = json.loads(raw.data)
  111	        except json.JSONDecodeError:
  112	            continue
  113	        etype = payload.get("type") or raw.event
  114	        if etype is None and "error" in payload:  # DeepSeek unnamed error frame
  115	            error = payload["error"]
  116	            continue
  117	
  118	        if etype == "message_start":
  119	            msg = copy.deepcopy(payload["message"])
  120	            msg["content"] = []
  121	        elif etype == "content_block_start":
  122	            i = payload["index"]
  123	            block = copy.deepcopy(payload["content_block"])
  124	            if block.get("type") in ("tool_use", "server_tool_use"):
  125	                partial_json[i] = ""
  126	            blocks[i] = block
  127	        elif etype == "content_block_delta":
  128	            i, d = payload["index"], payload["delta"]
  129	            b = blocks.setdefault(i, {})
  130	            dt = d.get("type")
  131	            if dt == "text_delta":
  132	                b["text"] = b.get("text", "") + d["text"]
  133	            elif dt == "input_json_delta":
  134	                partial_json[i] = partial_json.get(i, "") + d["partial_json"]
  135	            elif dt == "thinking_delta":
  136	                b["thinking"] = b.get("thinking", "") + d["thinking"]
  137	            elif dt == "signature_delta":
  138	                b["signature"] = b.get("signature", "") + d["signature"]
  139	            elif dt == "citations_delta":
  140	                b.setdefault("citations", []).append(d["citation"])
  141	            else:
  142	                b.setdefault("_unknown_deltas", []).append(d)
  143	        elif etype == "content_block_stop":
  144	            i = payload["index"]
  145	            if i in partial_json:
  146	                pj = partial_json.pop(i)
  147	                try:
  148	                    blocks[i]["input"] = json.loads(pj) if pj else blocks[i].get("input", {})
  149	                except json.JSONDecodeError:
  150	                    blocks[i]["_partial_json"] = pj
  151	        elif etype == "message_delta":
  152	            if msg is None:
  153	                msg = {"content": []}
  154	            for k, v in (payload.get("delta") or {}).items():
  155	                msg[k] = v
  156	            usage = payload.get("usage") or {}
  157	            # message_delta usage is cumulative: later non-null values win.
  158	            mu = msg.setdefault("usage", {})
  159	            for k, v in usage.items():
  160	                if v is not None:
  161	                    mu[k] = v
  162	        elif etype == "message_stop":
  163	            complete = True
  164	        elif etype == "error":
  165	            error = payload.get("error", payload)
  166	        # "ping" and unknown event types are ignored
  167	
  168	    if msg is None:
  169	        msg = {"content": []}
  170	    msg["content"] = [blocks[i] for i in sorted(blocks)]
  171	    msg["_stream_complete"] = complete
  172	    if error is not None:
  173	        msg["_stream_error"] = error
  174	    return msg
  175	
  176	
  177	def assemble_openai_chunks(events: list[SSEEvent | dict]) -> dict:
  178	    """Rebuild a ``chat.completion`` object from OpenAI-format stream chunks.
  179	
  180	    Tool calls arrive as fragments keyed by ``index``; the first fragment has
  181	    ``id`` and ``function.name``, later ones only ``function.arguments`` text.
  182	    """
  183	    out: dict = {}
  184	    choices: dict[int, dict] = {}
  185	    complete = False
  186	    error = None
  187	    for raw in events:
  188	        if isinstance(raw, dict):
  189	            raw = SSEEvent(raw.get("event"), raw.get("data", ""))
  190	        data = raw.data.strip()
  191	        if not data:
  192	            continue
  193	        if data == "[DONE]":
  194	            complete = True
  195	            continue
  196	        try:
  197	            payload = json.loads(data)
  198	        except json.JSONDecodeError:
  199	            continue
  200	        if "error" in payload and "choices" not in payload:
  201	            error = payload["error"]
  202	            continue
  203	        for k in ("id", "created", "model", "system_fingerprint"):
  204	            if payload.get(k) is not None:
  205	                out.setdefault(k, payload[k])
  206	        if payload.get("usage"):
  207	            out["usage"] = payload["usage"]
  208	        for ch in payload.get("choices") or []:
  209	            i = ch.get("index", 0)
  210	            c = choices.setdefault(i, {"index": i, "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": None},
  211	                                       "finish_reason": None})
  212	            msg = c["message"]
  213	            d = ch.get("delta") or {}
  214	            if d.get("role"):
  215	                msg["role"] = d["role"]
  216	            for fld in ("content", "reasoning_content"):
  217	                if d.get(fld) is not None:
  218	                    msg[fld] = (msg.get(fld) or "") + d[fld]
  219	            for tc in d.get("tool_calls") or []:
  220	                calls = msg.setdefault("tool_calls", [])
  221	                idx = tc.get("index", len(calls))
  222	                while len(calls) <= idx:
  223	                    calls.append({"id": None, "type": "function", "function": {"name": "", "arguments": ""}})
  224	                call = calls[idx]
  225	                if tc.get("id"):
  226	                    call["id"] = tc["id"]
  227	                if tc.get("type"):
  228	                    call["type"] = tc["type"]
  229	                fn = tc.get("function") or {}
  230	                if fn.get("name"):
  231	                    call["function"]["name"] += fn["name"]
  232	                if fn.get("arguments"):
  233	                    call["function"]["arguments"] += fn["arguments"]
  234	            if ch.get("finish_reason"):
  235	                c["finish_reason"] = ch["finish_reason"]
  236	    out["object"] = "chat.completion"
  237	    out["choices"] = [choices[i] for i in sorted(choices)]
  238	    out["_stream_complete"] = complete
  239	    if error is not None:
  240	        out["_stream_error"] = error
